# Your next shortlist. Sourced, screened, and ranked.

TaaSFlow helps your team find and evaluate candidates, with recruiting execution and a shared workspace to review the evidence. Your team keeps control of interviews and hiring decisions.

Start with one role for $699. One pilot per company.

[Request my $699 pilot](/pilot)
[See how it works](/how-it-works)

Looking for a job instead? [Browse jobs](/jobs)

One role, $699, one pilot per company
No placement fee
A recruiter reviews every shortlist
You make every hiring decision

## A shortlist you can check, not a stack of CVs.

Agents source and score candidates. A recruiter reviews every shortlist before you see it. You make every hiring decision.

### A ranked shortlist of up to 10 candidates

Ordered by how well each candidate meets the requirements you approved.

### The evidence behind each score

Each requirement points to the line in the CV or application that supports it, so you can check the reasoning.

### A shared workspace

Your team reviews candidates, compares them and moves them forward in one place.

### Human review

A recruiter reviews every shortlist before it reaches you. Your team runs the interviews and decides who to hire.

## Four steps from role brief to shortlist.

1. Share the role. Send a short inquiry or the full role brief. No sourcing starts until the scope is confirmed.
2. Approve the plan. We contact you to confirm the role, the criteria and the pilot scope before any work begins.
3. Sourcing and screening. Agents source and score candidates against your criteria. A recruiter reviews the results.
4. Review your shortlist. You get a ranked shortlist with the evidence behind each score, in your workspace. You decide who to interview.

## Compare the cost with agency fees.

Enter your own salary, agency fee and hiring volume. Every starting value is an editable example, not an industry average.

## Teams that hire in these areas.

- [Hospitality](/industries/hospitality): Roles at hotels, restaurants, resorts and event venues.
- [Healthcare](/industries/healthcare): Clinical, administrative and leadership roles where credentials matter.
- [High-volume and frontline hiring](/industries/retail): Roles you fill in numbers, such as retail and store teams.

## One role for $699, one time.

The pilot runs one role from brief to shortlist. You receive a ranked shortlist of up to 10 candidates, the evidence behind each score, and access to the shared workspace. The pilot is a paid evaluation of one role. It is not a free trial.

Packages cover up to 100 positions. There is no placement fee. [See pricing](/pricing)

## Before you start.

### What does it cost?

The pilot is $699 for one role, one time per company. The pilot is a paid evaluation of one role. It is not a free trial. Packages for more roles are on the pricing page. There is no placement fee.

### How fast do we get candidates?

Your first ranked shortlist usually arrives within 5 business days of an approved role brief. Timing depends on the role, the market and how quickly the brief is approved. It is not a guarantee.

### Who does the work?

Agents source and score candidates. A recruiter reviews every shortlist before you see it. You make every hiring decision.

### What does the pilot cover?

One role from brief to shortlist. You receive a ranked shortlist of up to 10 candidates, the evidence behind each score, and access to the shared workspace where your team reviews them.

### Who owns the candidate records?

You can export your candidate records at any time. Workspace access for a one-off package lasts three months; records are deleted after that unless you renew.

### Does it connect to our ATS?

The TaaSFlow workspace includes its own applicant tracking. Direct sync with an external ATS is planned, not built.
